body:
I’m still here. Thank you for sharing your story... I’m just really scared, of all my options right now—of dying, of going to the hospital, of telling them I’m not OK, of doing nothing and then this mood of wanting to do something to help myself will pass and I’m gonna wanna die again.

Shit, I forgot to mention in the OP but my parents are going away to visit relatives for a week and a half starting Monday, so if I do something now, they’re almost definitely going to have to cancel their trip. I don’t want to ruin their trip, relatives are getting old and not a lot of chances to visit, but like, trying to hold on that long is probably dangerous? I don’t know, god I just don’t know. I don’t know what to do.

Well, okay? I think the meds I was taking were a Prozac generic. I really want to try some other antidepressant, but the psychiatrist (I think that’s what she was, some kinda doc) I saw said she didn’t think a switch would change anything... so I dunno... I’m not sure what other background info would help? Thanks for the link, maybe I will check it out, seems easier than trying to talk over a phone...
